meta.name: seedance
meta.description: Generate videos with ByteDance Seedance 2.0 via inference.sh CLI. Unified model for text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video with synchronized audio, up to 1080p, 4-15s duration. Pro and Fast variants. Studio variants with private asset library for portrait consistency. Use for: social media videos, music videos, product demos, animated content, AI video with sound. Triggers: seedance, seedance 2, bytedance video, seedance t2v, seedance i2v, seedance r2v, video with audio, seedance 2.0, bytedance seedance, seedance studio

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用字节跳动 Seedance 2.0 生成带同步音频的视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成带音频的 AI 视频用于社交媒体或产品展示
copy.tagline_en: Generate videos with synchronized audio using ByteDance Seedance 2.0
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create AI videos with audio for social media or product showcases

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过命令行调用字节跳动的 Seedance 2.0 模型生成带同步音频的视频。支持文字转视频、图片转视频、参考素材转视频，最长 15 秒，最高 1080p。
howto.when: 当你提到“seedance”、“字节跳动视频”、“文字转视频”等关键词，或要求生成带声音的 AI 视频时触发。

say.text: 用 Seedance 生成一段海浪拍打岩石的视频，带音频，10 秒，16:9。
say.note: 会调用 Seedance 2.0 生成视频并返回下载链接。

say.text: 把这张图片变成视频，加上轻柔的镜头运动。
say.note: 会使用图片转视频模式，图片作为首帧。

say.text: 用 Seedance Studio 生成一段人物肖像一致的视频。
say.note: 会使用 Studio 模型，上传参考图片到私有资产库。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate videos with synchronized audio using ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 via CLI. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video, up to 15 seconds, up to 1080p.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "seedance", "ByteDance video", "text-to-video", or ask to generate AI video with sound.

say_en.text: Generate a video of ocean waves crashing on rocks with audio, 10 seconds, 16:9.
say_en.note: Calls Seedance 2.0 and returns a download link.

say_en.text: Animate this image into a video with gentle camera movement.
say_en.note: Uses image-to-video mode with the image as first frame.

say_en.text: Use Seedance Studio to generate a video with consistent portrait.
say_en.note: Uses Studio model, uploads reference image to private asset library.
